Class ResearchPaper

java.lang.Object
Models.ResearchPaper
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ResearchPaper>
public class ResearchPaper extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<ResearchPaper>
Represents an academic publication in the university research system.

Core fields follow the IEEE metadata schema: title, authors, journal, page count, publication date, DOI, citation count, and research field. Optional fields (abstractText, keywords) can be set after construction via setters.

Natural ordering (Comparable) is by citation count descending, so sorted collections and Collections.sort rank the most-cited papers first by default. Use explicit Comparator instances (e.g. by date or pages) where a different order is required.

Equality and hashing are based on DOI when present; two papers with the same DOI are considered the same publication regardless of other fields.
